sourceId.description: Stable identifier for the sensor/source namespace, mapped by the kid.

trackGeneration.description: Identifier for this lifetime of a source track ID; advance when a source recycles trackId.

testData.description: Source marks this report as test data. Encoders must preserve this status.

headerSimulated.description: Source frame marks all contained tracks as simulated.

simulated.description: Source marks this individual track as simulated.

confirmed.description: Source explicitly states whether this track is confirmed. Omission means the status is unknown.

coasting.description: Source marks this track as coasting.

finalUpdate.description: Source marks this as the final update for the track.

altitudeM.description: Height above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, in metres.

eastMps.description: Velocity toward east, metres per second.

northMps.description: Velocity toward north, metres per second.

classification.description: Billie track class. Kid mappings convert source-specific labels into this vocabulary.

confidence.description: Normalized confidence in [0,1]; sensor-specific scales are converted by the mapper.
